The '''Outland rifle''' was a bolt-action [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]].<ref name="LOW" />

==Characteristics==
An exceptionally sturdy rifle popular on backwater planets and the extreme edges of the galaxy, the Outland was reliable and easy to disassemble for storage and cleaning.<ref name="LOW" /> Like many slugthrowers the Outland propelled a metal slug at supersonic speeds through chemical explosion, and was noted for having an exceptionally long range of a kilometer and a half.<ref name="LOW" /> These slugs were heavier than most rifles, owing to their power and range, and as a result had to be manually advanced into the chamber through bolt-action, making rapid fire difficult.<ref name="G4" /> Its range, combined with a retractable stock, bipod, and optional [[NightMight 4NS scope]] made it ideally suited for long range hunting and killing.<ref name="LOW" />

Because of its sturdy construction, many used the rifle as a melee weapon - pairing the rifle with a [[bayonet]], using the rifle as a spear when hunting.<ref name="G4" /> Despite primarily being a sniping weapon, at least some of these rifles were modified for quick bursts of close-range fire.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Notable users==
[[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] inherited his [[Grievous's great-grandmother|great-grandmother]]'s<ref name="LOW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> Czerka Outland rifle and wielded it during the [[Huk War]] on his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], prior to his rebirth as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="SOLDIER">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>
